tools.name: get_connection
tools.description: Check the Sloosh connection, spending status and the daily allowance left. Call once at the start of a conversation.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Read a Sloosh guide by id: connection, spending, assets, generation, spaces, recovery, release-status.

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: List assets already in the Sloosh workspace.

tools.name: import_asset
tools.description: Import an image, video or audio file from any public HTTPS URL, including a signed URL that has not expired, and register it in the workspace library. Returns the asset kind and id.

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: Resolve a typed workspace or generated asset reference and its current URL. No permanent lifetime is promised.

tools.name: quote_generation
tools.description: Quote one generation: one prompt, one model, up to 4 outputs. Free. Returns a quoteId and its credits.

tools.name: generate
tools.description: Start a paid generation for a quote. Needs quoteId, a stable idempotencyKey and confirmed=true after the user approves the quote.

tools.name: show_generation
tools.description: Show a result card for up to 8 operation ids.

tools.name: get_space
tools.description: Read a published Space by its exact ID.

tools.name: get_space_input_schema
tools.description: Read the current published form schema before preparing a Space run.

tools.name: quote_space
tools.description: Validate a published Space's inputs and obtain a single-use capped credit quote. Does not start work. When warning is set, tell the user before they approve.

tools.name: run_space
tools.description: Run a previously quoted published Space. Set confirmed=true only after the user approves this quote. Reuse one idempotencyKey for retries.

tools.name: get_space_run
tools.description: Read durable Space execution state, pending checkpoints and final accounting. Poll until state is settled; owner.terminalStatus then says completed, failed or canceled.

tools.name: get_space_run_outputs
tools.description: List a Space run's outputs as links. After the run finishes, final is true and outputs holds each result's id, type, url and label.

tools.name: reconcile_space_run
tools.description: Recover an uncertain run using its original operation and quote. Never substitutes a new job.

tools.name: approve_space_checkpoint
tools.description: Approve the exact pending human checkpoint returned by get_space_run. Legacy Spaces have no checkpoints and refuse this.

tools.name: reject_space_checkpoint
tools.description: Reject the exact pending checkpoint of a Space run. Legacy Spaces have no checkpoints and refuse this.
